description_en: After the fusion authentication client completes initialization, you can call this API from your server to obtain an authentication token. You can then pass the authentication token to the SDK for authentication
description_zh: 融合认证客户端完成初始化操作后，由开发者服务器发起调用此接口，获取鉴权Token。获取到的鉴权Token用于传入SDK进行鉴权
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi get-fusion-auth-token --scheme-code FA10000000000000000201 --platform Android --duration-seconds 900 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFusionAuthToken

parameters.help_en: Required when Platform is Android. The app package name
parameters.help_zh: Platform为Android时必须传入，App的包名信息
parameters.name: package_name

parameters.help_en: Required when Platform is Android. The app package signature
parameters.help_zh: Platform为Android时必须传入，App的包签名信息
parameters.name: package_sign

parameters.help_en: Required when Platform is iOS. The app bundle ID
parameters.name: bundle_id

parameters.help_en: The platform. Valid values: Android or iOS
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the token, in seconds. Minimum value: 900. Maximum value: 43200
parameters.help_zh: Token有效时长，单位是秒，最小值900，最大值43200
parameters.name: duration_seconds

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates a successful request.

For other error codes, see the error code list
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见错误码列表

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Model.description_en: The authentication token string. Use this token to verify the client SDK during initialization
Model.description_zh: 返回的鉴权Token字符串。该鉴权Token主要用于客户端SDK初始化时进行合法性校验

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. Use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded. Valid values:

true: The call succeeded.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
API调用是否成功。取值：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
